g.text: Exact quartics with the full unit denominator
Degree-19 residual algebra; explicit mod-101 inverses
No phase makes both coefficients vanish
Even entire functions of exponential type
Each factor has a nonzero finite complex zero
Fixed old conductor: a finite singularity for every unit
Every inverse exterior norm diverges there

g.text: Vary phase at the fixed certified period
Both boundary phases also have nonzero fourth coefficient;
This argument alone does not certify its orbit or symbol order.
Global finite zeros and two exact conductor singularity paths
ANP1–32: exact coefficient elimination. GUC1–5: singularity for every unit. UPP17–20: original Gamma-metric exterior constants.
Original period source: PCL1–10. ES marking and human provenance: canonical version-69 reader, FSR1–24.
